# 264. Iteration 10 Phase 1: Formalize Transform & Caption Modifier Plugins

**Date:** 2026-10-18  
**Scope:** `packages/ir`, `packages/effect-engines`, `apps/studio`, `autogenerated-tests`  
**Paired Plan:** [`docs/master_integration_plan_iteration10.md`](file:///c:/Users/Admin/workspace/git/acc/docs/master_integration_plan_iteration10.md) & [`apps/studio/doc/implementation_plan_22.md`](file:///c:/Users/Admin/workspace/git/acc/apps/studio/doc/implementation_plan_22.md)

---

## Task Summary
In Phase 1 of Iteration 10, formalized `TransformModifierPlugin` (`transform`) and `CaptionModifierPlugin` (`text/style`) to eliminate ad-hoc transform and subtitle rendering code in preparation for canonical `IRCanvasCompositor` unification. Also tagged and guarded native Node `fs` usages in `Camera3DPlugin` and `Depth3DPlugin`, and unified client-side plugin exports.

---

## Detailed Changes

### 1. TransformModifierPlugin
* Created [`packages/ir/src/plugins/transform/TransformModifierPlugin.ts`](file:///c:/Users/Admin/workspace/git/acc/packages/ir/src/plugins/transform/TransformModifierPlugin.ts):
  * `type = 'transform'`, `targetScope = 'both'`, `targetPhase = 2`.
  * Evaluates deterministic sequence motion (`evaluateSequenceMotion`) for `pop_in`, `slide_left`, `bounce`, `overshoot`, and `drift`.
  * In `renderClipSpace()`, stacks 2D affine matrix transformations: `ctx.translate(cx + x, cy + y)`, `ctx.rotate(rad)`, `ctx.scale(s, s)`, `ctx.globalAlpha = opacity`.

### 2. CaptionModifierPlugin
* Created [`packages/ir/src/plugins/text/CaptionModifierPlugin.ts`](file:///c:/Users/Admin/workspace/git/acc/packages/ir/src/plugins/text/CaptionModifierPlugin.ts):
  * `type = 'text/style'`, `targetScope = 'both'`, `targetPhase = 2`.
  * Integrates with `BoundedAcousticCaptionStrategy` and `drawCanvasCaptionsFromSnapshot` with `SafeZoneManager` platform support.
  * WeakMap cache for `CaptionConfig[]` to maintain `ZERO-ALLOC-FRAME-LOOP`.

### 3. Node/FFI Guarding & Isomorphic Exports
* Added `// TODO(isomorphic-migration)` and defensive guards `typeof fs?.existsSync === 'function'` in:
  * [`Camera3DPlugin.ts`](file:///c:/Users/Admin/workspace/git/acc/packages/ir/src/plugins/vfx/Camera3DPlugin.ts)
  * [`Depth3DPlugin.ts`](file:///c:/Users/Admin/workspace/git/acc/packages/ir/src/plugins/vfx/Depth3DPlugin.ts)
* Updated [`packages/ir/src/plugins/index.ts`](file:///c:/Users/Admin/workspace/git/acc/packages/ir/src/plugins/index.ts) with `TransformModifierPlugin`, `CaptionModifierPlugin`, and backward-compatibility aliases.
* Updated [`packages/ir/src/plugins/clientRegistry.ts`](file:///c:/Users/Admin/workspace/git/acc/packages/ir/src/plugins/clientRegistry.ts) to register real `TransformModifierPlugin` and `CaptionModifierPlugin` while stubbing Node-dependent plugins for browser builds.
* Exported caption tools in [`packages/effect-engines/src/client.ts`](file:///c:/Users/Admin/workspace/git/acc/packages/effect-engines/src/client.ts).

### 4. Verification & Testing
* Created [`autogenerated-tests/ir_phase1_transform_caption_plugins.test.ts`](file:///c:/Users/Admin/workspace/git/acc/autogenerated-tests/ir_phase1_transform_caption_plugins.test.ts) covering parameter validation, motion evaluation, clip-space matrix translation, and caption rendering.
* Verified existing test suites: `ir_phase1_transform_caption_plugins`, `modifier_plugin_registry_studio_integration`, `studio_phase1_declarative_vfx`, `studio_phase4_inspector_hud_particles`, and `video_ir_phase4_engine` (31/31 tests passing).
* Verified production build: `bun run studio:build` exits 0 (3.29s).
